name: Skills CLI Funnel
description: Install funnel for the `npx @agent-native/skills@latest` and `npx @agent-native/core@latest skills` CLIs, tracked via first-party analytics. Each run is a distinct session_id; unique installs are distinct anonymous_id. Source: first-party analytics_events.

panels.title: Total CLI starts
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli started'

panels.title: Unique installs (people)
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT anonymous_id) AS count FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name LIKE 'skills_cli %'

panels.title: Completed installs
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS count FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli install completed'

config.description: Distinct runs that reached install completed

panels.title: Overall completion rate
panels.sql: WITH started AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS n FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli started'), completed AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS n FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli install completed') SELECT CASE WHEN started.n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(completed.n * 100.0 / started.n) END AS rate FROM started CROSS JOIN completed

config.description: Distinct sessions reaching install completed / distinct sessions that started, x100

panels.title: Funnel by step
panels.sql: WITH steps AS (SELECT 1 AS step_order, 'Started' AS step, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS count FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli started' UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Skills prompted', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli skills prompted' UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Skills selected', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli skills selected' UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Clients selected', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli clients selected' UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Scope selected', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli scope selected' UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Install completed', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli install completed' UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Completed', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli completed') SELECT step, count FROM steps ORDER BY step_order

config.description: Distinct runs (session_id) reaching each step, in funnel order

panels.title: CLI starts over time
panels.sql: SELECT substr(timestamp, 1, 10) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli started' GROUP BY substr(timestamp, 1, 10) ORDER BY date

panels.title: Starts by CLI
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(properties::jsonb ->> 'cli', ''), 'unknown') AS cli, COUNT(*) AS count FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli started' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(properties::jsonb ->> 'cli', ''), 'unknown') ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Starts by platform
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(properties::jsonb ->> 'platform', ''), 'unknown') AS platform, COUNT(*) AS count FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli started' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(properties::jsonb ->> 'platform', ''), 'unknown') ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Scope chosen
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(properties::jsonb ->> 'scope', ''), 'unknown') AS scope, COUNT(*) AS count FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli scope selected' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(properties::jsonb ->> 'scope', ''), 'unknown') ORDER BY count DESC

config.description: project vs user scope at the scope step

panels.title: Clients chosen
panels.sql: WITH lists AS (SELECT properties::jsonb ->> 'clients' AS list FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli clients selected' AND (properties::jsonb ->> 'clients') <> ''), positions AS (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10), items AS (SELECT trim(CASE positions.n WHEN 1 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 1) WHEN 2 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 2) WHEN 3 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 3) WHEN 4 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 4) WHEN 5 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 5) WHEN 6 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 6) WHEN 7 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 7) WHEN 8 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 8) WHEN 9 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 9) WHEN 10 THEN split_part(lists.list, ',', 10) END) AS client FROM lists CROSS JOIN positions) SELECT client, COUNT(*) AS count FROM items WHERE client <> '' GROUP BY client ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 30

config.description: Occurrences of each client across the `clients` property of clients selected events, counting the first 10 names in each run's list

panels.title: Dropoff between steps
panels.sql: WITH steps AS (SELECT 1 AS step_order, 'Started' AS step, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS reached FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli started' UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Skills prompted', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli skills prompted' UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Skills selected', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli skills selected' UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Clients selected', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli clients selected' UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Scope selected', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli scope selected' UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Install completed', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli install completed' UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Completed', COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli completed'), start_total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS n FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'skills_cli started') SELECT steps.step, steps.reached, CASE WHEN start_total.n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(steps.reached * 100.0 / start_total.n) END AS pct_of_start FROM steps CROSS JOIN start_total ORDER BY steps.step_order

config.description: Distinct runs reaching each step and percent of starting runs, in funnel order
